title: Drug-Drug Interaction Study of Rucaparib, Rosuvastatin and Oral Contraceptives

sections.abstract: This study will investigate the drug-drug interactions (DDIs) between rucaparib and oral rosuvastatin (Arm A), and between rucaparib and oral ethinylestradiol and levonorgestrel (Arm B), with rucaparib as a perpetrator.
